chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Al-Sayyari, raising it, said:
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) liked the gourd, and he would order his wives, when they cooked a pot, to be frequent with the gourd, and it is the pumpkin.
ai.seo_question: What food did the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) particularly like and instruct his wives to cook often?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from al-Sayyari via al-Husayn ibn Muhammad underscores the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) specific fondness for gourd (qar’), linking it to the domestic practices of his wives. In Shia scholarly tradition, this is often cited as evidence for the permissibility and virtue of consuming humble, everyday foods, reflecting the Prophet’s modesty and appreciation for simple sustenance.
